data.description: Play NAS media with a single command and control playback progress
data.descriptionEn: Play NAS media with a single command and control playback progress
data.descriptionZh: 一句话点播NAS影片，控制播放进度
data.readme:
· Support playing movies, TV series, and animations.
· Pause, resume, go to previous/next song, or previous/next episode, etc
· If it’s unclear whether to play music or video, it will judge based on current playback or ask for clarification
data.readmeEn:
· Support playing movies, TV series, and animations.
· Pause, resume, go to previous/next song, or previous/next episode, etc
· If it’s unclear whether to play music or video, it will judge based on current playback or ask for clarification
data.readmeZh:
· 支持播放电影、电视剧、动画
· 可以暂停、继续、切到上一首/下一首、上一集/下一集
· 如果没说清楚是听歌还是看视频，会先根据当前播放内容判断，判断不了会追问
